correctness.rationale: The external published inequalities match the exactly enumerated singularity class. Reconstructing near-free r=k and local Tjurina/Bezout leads to the stated F inequality and a universal k<=6 proof, including an exact integer contradiction at k=7. The no-triples boundary reduces to one k=5 integer vector; the A7 graph is triangle-free by an explicit conic restriction normal form. Exact standalone Python/SymPy verification confirms the four-conic sharpness example, including mdr=3 and its incidence scheme.

The uniquely forced five-conic incidence profile and K2,3 contact graph materially reduce the remaining geometric realization problem; the nodes+A7 special bound is sharp.
